notes_for_editor: Thin record: one register entry plus the register's New Jersey list. Two web searches and the NJ DEP fire-tower page (returned empty) found nothing on this site. The 1900 build date rests on the register's Built field alone. Record has no county field; the register says Sussex County. Fact-check 2026-10-10: status changed from 'gone' to 'unknown'. The register's former-site listing is not a removal record and no source says what remains; the story makes no claim either way.
